658:t_1:4.en:
???
「Time and distance mean nothing between you and me.」

658:t_1:5.en:
???
「You must have noticed it too. Every time you're enveloped in the radiance of $$ゲッター線$$, you come into contact with our legion.」

658:t_1:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I figured the power of Shin Shine Spark was making me hallucinate.」

658:t_1:7.en:
???
「For now, I'll commend you. You've opened one of the doors.」

658:t_1:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You mean becoming one with $$真ゲッター$$...」

658:t_1:9.en:
???
「With that power, you should be able to win the battles to come as well.」

658:t_1:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Looks like we've managed to hold the dimensional rift in check for now.」

658:t_1:11.en:
???
「For an instant, your life's power... the force that seeks to exist, surpassed the force that seeks to vanish. This is the result.」

658:t_1:12.en:
???
「And you are not the only one. Your comrades will eventually open the door too.」

658:t_1:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「What the hell is this place...?!」

658:t_1:15.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Awesome! It's a huge parade of all kinds of $$ゲッター$$s!」

658:t_1:16.en:
$$シモン$$
「Some of those $$ゲッター$$s are bigger than $$超銀河グレンラガン$$!」

658:t_1:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Perhaps $$ゲッター$$s from parallel worlds are gathered here.」

658:t_1:18.en:
$$シン$$
「This isn't the time to be so relaxed! Right, $$竜馬$$?!」

658:t_1:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「Which one should we address in this case?」

658:t_1:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Who knows... But either one will probably do.」

658:t_1:22.en:
$$隼人$$
「He's $$流竜馬$$, no matter which world he's from.」

658:t_1:26.en:
???
「You and they are the chosen ones.」

658:t_1:27.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're wrong. We're the ones who chose...」

658:t_1:30.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm starting to get a vague idea of what you're fighting too. But...」

658:t_1:31.en:
???
「You need say no more. Fight in your own world.」

658:t_1:32.en:
???
「The end of myth is your battlefield.」

658:t_1:34.en:
???
「Yes. Every world will converge there, and that place will become the beginning of a new century.」

658:t_1:35.en:
???
「Fight, warriors. To carry your lives into the future...」

658:t_2:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「...So the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ had joined forces with Aide $$三島$$ of the $$フロンティア船団$$...」

658:t_2:5.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「He secretly contacted the survivors of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and pursued his own plan, without even $$大統領$$ $$ハワード$$ knowing.」

658:t_2:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Was his plan to become president of the $$フロンティア船団$$?」

658:t_2:7.en:
$$クラン$$
「That would have been harmless by comparison.」

658:t_2:8.en:
$$クラン$$
「Using $$バジュラ$$ controlled by combining $$インプラント$$ technology with $$フォールドウェーブ$$s, and an army of mass-produced $$ストライカー#robot$$s...」

658:t_2:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「He tried to become the ruler of this universe.」

658:t_2:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「He did that even though the universe might be about to collapse?」

658:t_2:11.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's how narrow his outlook was.」

658:t_2:12.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Apparently he planned to defeat the $$宇宙怪獣$$ with the $$バジュラ$$'s power, and if that failed, transfer to a parallel world.」

658:t_2:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「What a carefree bastard, when the great collapse that happens once every 120 million years might affect every world.」

658:t_2:14.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「We settled things with $$ミカゲ$$, who tried to use $$ランカ$$-chan as a tool for his revenge. Then we fought the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ on the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld.」

658:t_2:15.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Incidentally, the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ disposed of $$レオン・三島$$ during that battle because he'd outlived his usefulness.」

658:t_2:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「So that's the end of a man whose ambitions exceeded his worth...」

658:t_2:17.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s executives had taken a form that housed multiple human consciousnesses in a single unit.」

658:t_2:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So they abandoned human form...」

658:t_2:19.en:
$$レド$$
「It seems they too were trying to become something beyond human.」

658:t_2:20.en:
$$さやか$$
「And... was $$ランカ$$ all right?」

658:t_2:21.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Somehow, yeah. In the end, $$ミカゲ$$ fused with the $$堕天翅$$ $$頭翅#pilot$$, who came for him, and left with old man $$不動$$.」

658:t_2:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「That guy's as hard to figure out as ever...」

658:t_2:23.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Apparently Supreme Commander $$不動$$ is really a $$堕天翅$$... specifically $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the Wings of the Sun.」

658:t_2:24.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean the one who was that $$堕天翅$$ $$ミカゲ$$'s lover...?!」

658:t_2:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then he was the root of all this trouble!」

658:t_2:26.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You could look at it that way.」

658:t_2:27.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Well, whatever. The war with the $$堕天翅$$ is over now.」

658:t_2:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「But looking at it that way, I can see why he was always saying cryptic things...」

658:t_2:29.en:
$$リディ$$
「He was fulfilling his mission as a higher-dimensional life-form, like $$ゼウス$$... avoiding direct interference.」

658:t_2:30.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ and each fleet's $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ helped us fight on the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld.」

658:t_2:31.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Apparently they'll all join the Galactic Raid Fleet and take part in the battle against the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

658:t_2:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So the decisive battle is finally here...」

658:t_2:33.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Before that, one other thing got settled.」

658:t_2:35.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Things between $$アルト$$ and $$シェリル$$ got settled.」

658:t_2:38.en:
$$クラン$$
「If you're worried about $$ランカ$$, there's no need. It was settled in a way all three of them could accept.」

658:t_2:40.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Now all that's left is to head for the galactic center.」

658:t_2:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「If the $$宇宙怪獣$$ are the true $$バアル$$, defeating them should weaken the force that seeks to vanish and stop the universe's great collapse.」

658:t_2:42.en:
$$リディ$$
「Our next battle... will decide the universe's fate...」

658:t_2:43.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We must win. For every life in this universe...」

658:t_2:46.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... It's nothing... I'm just a little tired...」

658:t_2:47.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's unusual. I never expected to hear you say that, $$竜馬$$.」

658:t_2:48.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Well, it's no wonder. Even we were shocked by $$真ゲッター$$'s power then, and we were riding in it with him.」

kept_omissions: 658:t_1:13: The proof is not stated before the comrades arrive and demonstrate it.
658:t_1:23: Ryoma recognizes his comrades with an unfinished identifying address.
658:t_1:27: Ryoma says he has chosen his path here; t_1:28 gives that path as fighting and living.
658:t_1:28: The purpose phrase completes the choice made in t_1:27; it remains separate to preserve the spoken turn.
658:t_1:30: Ryoma's objection trails after "But"; his alternate self answers in t_1:31.
658:t_1:33: The end of myth is repeated as a questioning identification, before the explanation in t_1:34.
658:t_2:8: The instruments of Mishima's plan are listed here; t_2:9 supplies the main clause about becoming humanity's ruler.
658:t_2:37: The unresolved concern about Ranka trails after "But then"; Klan answers it in t_2:38.
658:t_2:44: Silent reaction; no spoken grammatical clause exists in the source.
658:t_1:35: The command to fight is followed by its purpose as a detached phrase: carrying the warriors' lives into the future.
658:t_2:43: The complete statement that they must win is followed by a detached dedication to every life in the universe.
coordinator_resolutions: 658:t_2:8: Whole-corpus exact Japanese review; apply batch11 researched Queen of Roses / Fold Wave terminology, retaining plural suffix. Original source and prior snapshots preserved.
